answer.summary: All 8 failures are in graph-interactions.spec.ts (firefox, std-arm64), which the change does not touch; the change only edits OpenCRQ/XtmOne Java files. The only concrete cause in the excerpt is a deterministic CSP Report-Only violation (missing 'unsafe-eval') from a frontend asset, captured by a problems-array assertion. That is not obviously flaky, so a rerun will probably fail the same way. The other seven failure messages are elided, so the cause is not confirmed and confidence is low.
